chapter: Moving to California and the war years
title: Arrested for marijuana in Los Angeles
summary: He was jailed 45 days in the L.A. County Jail for a joint and swore off pot afterwards.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Uh-huh. And that was when -- so that was when you kind of -- you got arrested.
Yeah, I got locked up for pot.
And so forth. Where was that? It was here in Los Angeles, but where?

Right here in L.A. Right here in L.A., with a joint. I thought I'd got rid of the joint. Because when they arrested me, a big man come in there with a guy -- the guy was working in the toilet. He was selling it. And me, like a damned fool, I went in there and bought one from him, and instead of me smoking it up after I bought it from him and getting it, you know, I had it on me.

And that's what I was caught with. Right there in the County Jail, I done 45 days in there, which I hope to God it's over with, because it ain't no play thing. And I ain't ashamed of it, but yet and still it learnt me a lesson not to have it no more.
And I ain't had none since. And don't want no more. And don't want to be around nobody that's got it, because it ain't no plaything. Them 45 days, boy, I was so miserable, it was pitiful.

No. They give you oatmeal. They give you oatmeal, they don't give you no milk. Just oatmeal, period. And if you don't get a little bottle of milk, what they're selling in there, you ain't got no milk, because they sure don't give it to you. That's all I can remember right now.
